resumeText:
Arjun Menon | Kochi | arjun.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Video Editor, Backwater Media Works, Kochi (2022 - present)
- Edit brand films and YouTube videos in Adobe Premiere Pro for 12 consumer brands.
- Cut 30 vertical Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts a month with fast hooks and captions.
- Build lower thirds and logo animation in After Effects for product launch videos.
- Do colour correction and colour grading in DaVinci Resolve to match multi-camera shoots.
- Export final masters to platform delivery specs for YouTube, Instagram and OTT ads.

Junior Editor, Lagoon Studio, Kochi (2021 - 2022)
- Assembled rough cuts for wedding and event films from client footage.
- Organised client footage and project bins for the senior editor.

EDUCATION
BSc Visual Communication, St. Albert's College, 2021

SKILLS
Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Audition
